scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @luup/server typecheck && bun run --filter @luup/frontend typecheck
scripts.lint: oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings --report-unused-disable-directives -D typescript/await-thenable -D typescript/no-floating-promises -D typescript/no-misused-promises -D typescript/only-throw-error -D typescript/switch-exhaustiveness-check .
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings --report-unused-disable-directives -D typescript/await-thenable -D typescript/no-floating-promises -D typescript/no-misused-promises -D typescript/only-throw-error -D typescript/switch-exhaustiveness-check --fix .
scripts.ci: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run knip && bun run build && bun run test:coverage && bun run --filter @luup/frontend test
